assumptions: The design fork was decided by the human before this lane started: split along a seam, never raise the 1800-LOC ceiling, refresh a baseline, or add a deltaAllowances entry. The perf delta rule is unwaivable here (--admin cannot bypass a red required check), so paydown was the only legal route.

The seam chosen is the subcommand family (record / publish / reporting, alongside the pre-existing retention), not persistence. Persistence was rejected as the seam because it is not what grows and has ~20 external import sites: moving it would lower a number without separating a concern.

Module LOC was measured by planting a known-size probe file and reading the reported total back; the metric is not otherwise printed. Confirmed empirically: subdirectories are their own arch modules, .test.ts files are excluded entirely, comments are counted.

All measurements are against this branch's own base, 76d3f19b. Two peer PRs that land before this one are NOT in it: #1078 (#1057) removes ~35 LOC of non-test source from ts/src/history, and #1083 (#990) deletes classifyFlakeTrend / FlakeTrend / TREND_THRESHOLD (44 deletions across 2 source files). The post-merge absolute will be lower than the 1093 recorded here; the ~700 LOC of headroom this change contributes is the delta to hold it to, and it is independent of those two.

Every family module is named cli.ts because two separate constraints require it: layer binding is by filename (ts/src/**/*cli*.ts binds the cli layer, first match wins) and the perf baseline's standing coupling allowance is globbed at ts/src/**/cli.ts. A differently-named helper module trips coupling as a brand-new finding.

No entropy.entryPoints / performance.entryPoints declaration was added. The new modules are reachable from ts/src/main.ts through ordinary imports, the same reason retention/ needed none in #1073; the entropy ratchet measured +0 findings against the merge base, which confirms it.

CI green is NOT claimed. The four gates and all four CI-only ratchets (perf identity delta, entropy, docs, arch-verdict) were reproduced locally against a detached worktree at 76d3f19b and were green there; CI is verified independently.
keyword_rationale: Both acceptance bullets are met and demonstrated rather than asserted. (1) Adding a new history subcommand no longer trips either wall: a plausible 147-line subcommand was planted and measured at +2 LOC against 707 of module headroom, 7 imports against a 15 threshold, 147 lines against a 300 file threshold, and a coupling finding covered by the standing ts/src/**/cli.ts allowance -- then removed. (2) The headroom is deliberate and recorded: the seam, the rejected alternative, and the before/after numbers with their base SHA are in the proposal; the rule 'a new history subcommand opens its own <family>/cli.ts, it does not grow the root' is in the command root's header and enforced by ts/test/history-seam.test.ts, which fails at the desk because all three ratchets that would otherwise catch it are CI-only.
